calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark instrument, fade its completed five-session return relative to the same-date median return across the 15-instrument universe, scaled by trailing 20-session daily volatility. Forward return is next completed close-to-close return.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC and ICIR remained positive in 2020-22 (0.045063/0.131875), 2023-24 (0.028811/0.084405), and 2025-26 (0.035570/0.111817). Five-day predictive decay is positive but below the daily admission gate; ten-day effect is negligible. Small cross-section warrants conservative interpretation.
